scientific_limitations: Exact three labeled colors, positive uniform nearest-neighbor antiferromagnetic coupling and cyclic two-row prisms of length at least three; local minima allow energy-neutral moves. Uniformly sampled metastable states are not kinetic quench probabilities. Unindexed finite-width metastability literature could overlap.
title: Exact metastable entropy and positive frustration in the three-state antiferromagnetic Potts prism
